get.description:
Learning Activity Reports API

This resource represents LinkedIn Learning activity reports like course completions, seconds of content viewed and learner logins. You can use these methods to aggregate activity data by account, group, individual or content.

Documentation: [https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/reference/learning-activity-reports-reference#definitions](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/reference/learning-activity-reports-reference#definitionsParameters)

*Access to LinkedIn Learning APIs is available to members of our [Partner Program](https://learning.linkedin.com/partners) and organizations that have purchased LinkedIn Learning site licenses.*

get.summary: Learning Assets by Individual Asset URN
get.description:
To retrieve an individual learning asset, given an URN, issue a GET request to the following endpoint:
GET https://api.linkedin.com/v2/learningAssets/{URN}

The URN types supported by this endpoint are "urn:li:lyndaCourse", "urn:li:lyndaChapter", and "urn:li:lyndaVideo".


Documentation: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/integrations/retrieve-an-individual-learning-object#learningassets-get

*Access to LinkedIn Learning APIs is available to members of our [Partner Program](https://learning.linkedin.com/partners) and organizations that have purchased LinkedIn Learning site licenses.*

parameters.name: targetLocale.language
parameters.description: The locale language the API will use to try to localize the learning asset. The value of this parameter should be de, en, es, fr, or ja. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: targetLocale.country
parameters.description: The locale country the API will use to try to localize the learning asset. The value of this parameter should be DE, US, ES, FR, or JP. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: expandDepth
parameters.description: The number of levels in the learning asset hierarchy to include asset details. Default is 1.

parameters.name: includeRetired
parameters.description: Whether to include retired learning assets. The value of this parameter should be true or false.

get.summary: Learning Assets by Locale and Type
get.description:
To retrieve a page of learning assets, given some criteria, issue a GET call to the following endpoint:
GET https://api.linkedin.com/v2/learningAssets?q=localeAndType

Documentation: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/integrations/locale-and-type-api#learningassets-localeandtype-finder

*Access to LinkedIn Learning APIs is available to members of our [Partner Program](https://learning.linkedin.com/partners) and organizations that have purchased LinkedIn Learning site licenses.*

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The value of this parameter should always be: localeAndType.

parameters.name: sourceLocale.language
parameters.description: The locale language of the learning assets. The value of this parameter should be de, en, es, fr, or ja. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: sourceLocale.country
parameters.description: The locale country of the learning assets. The value of this parameter should be DE, US, ES, FR, or JP. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: expandDepth
parameters.description: The number of levels in the learning asset hierarchy to include asset details. This parameter is optional; please see the Specifying the level of asset details section for an explanation with examples.

parameters.name: includeRetired
parameters.description: Whether to include retired learning assets. The value of this parameter should be true or false.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start index of learning assets for the page.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of learning assets to include in the page. Please choose a reasonable value if overriding the default; the API will return an error if the requested page exceeds the 2 MB response size limit of the framework.

get.description:
To retrieve learning classifications for a keyboard, use a GET request supplied with a keyword to receive all of the classifications for that keyword. [https://api.linkedin.com/v2/learningClassifications?q=keyword&keyword=business](https://api.linkedin.com/v2/learningClassifications/{URN})

Documentation: [https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/reference/learningclassifications#keyword](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/reference/learningclassifications#keyword)

*Access to LinkedIn Learning APIs is available to members of our [Partner Program](https://learning.linkedin.com/partners) and organizations that have purchased LinkedIn Learning site licenses.*

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The value of this parameter should always be keyword.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The keyword string to search learning classifications. The search results will include only learning classifications matching this keyword string, as determined by LinkedIn Learning's relevance algorithm. The value of this parameter is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: sourceLocale.country
parameters.description: The locale country the API will use to try to localize the learning classification. The value of this parameter should be DE, US, ES, FR, or JP. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: sourceLocale.language
parameters.description: The locale language the API will use to try to localize the learning classification. The value of this parameter should be de, en, es, fr, or ja. These values correspond to the locales "de_DE", "en_US", "es_ES", "fr_FR", and "ja_JP".

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start index of learning classifications for the page.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of learning classifications to include in the page. The maximum supported count is 100 classifications per page.

post.description:
Creates a Dynamic Spotlight Ad Creative.

A successful response returns a `201 Created HTTP` status code and the ID in the `x-linkedin-id` response header. For example, `urn:li:sponsoredCreative:123456789`

##
This API creates a sponsored content by adding the action as createInline.

get.description: You can search for creative content in order to get a collection of creatives matching your search parameters. The Creative API currently supports search by `creative id`, `campaign`, `account`, `content reference`, `intendedStatus`, `leadgenCreativeCallToActionDestinations` and test fields. The API supports finding creatives from multiple accounts. The values within each field are displayed with 'or' (ORed) and values across fields are displayed with 'and' (ANDed).

post.description:
You can change the details of following Creatives fields:

\*   `intendedStatus`:
\*   `leadgenCallToAction`: field `adFormUrn` - The ad form that is a target destination for the `callToAction` button. It can only be modified when the creative is in DRAFT status. It is read only once it is set for a creative and once it transitions to any non-draft intended status.
\*   `leadgenCallToAction`: field label `-Label` for the `callToAction` button
    

  
This API updates a sponsored creative.

delete.description:
A Creative can be deleted. Use DELETE method to delete a creative that meets one of the following conditions. To start the process of deleting other creative, update the status to `PENDING_DELETION`.

\*   It is in a DRAFT state.
\*   It is linked to a Campaign in a DRAFT state.
\*   It is a video ad creative and `processingState` is `PROCESSING_FAILED`.
    

The header X-RestLi-Method must be included in the request and set to `DELETE`.

get.description:
At this point, the user has picked the sponsored account they are trying to collect leads for and you have validated they have proper access to the ad account and associated company page. This step will retrieve the form(s) associated with the selected sponsored account.

---

**6\. Map Lead Gen Form fields to destination fields**

Using the API response data from the previous step, your application should ask the user to map questions, consents, and hidden fields to the appropriate fields in the destination system (e.g. a CRM). All questions, consents, and hidden fields from the form should be mappable. `predefinedField` fields may be mapped automatically for the user, but all others will require the user to map them manually. Optionally, allow the user to map the ad account id, ad account name, campaign id, campaign name, creative id, creative name, form id, and form name (this additional metadata can be pulled back via the `leadFormResponses` endpoint in the next step). This additional metadata helps your customers with lead attribution.

**Quick tip:** When it comes to mapping the `predefinedField` fields that are auto populated from the member’s profile, it's important to understand that the localized language of the form could be a language other than English. Due to this, you should use the `predefinedField` field so the user doesn't have to map the same field in different form languages separately. For custom questions you will need to use the `question` field as there is no predefinedField for custom questions.

| **Field** | **Language Information** |
| --- | --- |
| name | This value will be translated to the localized language of the user who created the form (which could be different than the localized language of the form) |
| predefinedField | ENUM for the pre-populated field |
| question | This value will be translated to the localized form language |

This example pulls back all form responses (leads) for the chosen sponsored account. It also uses [field projection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/shared/api-guide/concepts/projections?context=linkedin/marketing/context) to pull back specific fields in the response and the `submittedAtTimeRange` field to pull back leads up to 365 days in the past.

Currently the only sponsored leadType is `SPONSORED`

LinkedIn will store form response (lead) data for up to 365 days. It is a best practice to allow the user to do a one time pull upon integration setup to ensure no leads are missed.

Refer to [Lead Form Responses](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/lead-sync/leadsync?tabs=http#get-lead-sync-form-responses) documentation for more information.

get.description:
This API endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve information about DMA lead generation forms. The request URL is `{{baseUrl}}/dmaLeadGenForm` with a query parameter `ids` that takes a list of lead generation form URNs.

### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| owner | String | The URN of the organization |
| leadGenFormID | String | The ID of the leadGenForm |
| q | String | The query parameter "owner" |

### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| results | Object | A dictionary containing the information about the lead generation forms. |
| results.{form_urn} | Object | Information about a specific lead generation form identified by its URN. |
| results.{form_urn}.owner | String | The owner of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.hiddenFields | Array | A list of hidden fields in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.versionId | Integer | The version ID of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.created | Integer | The timestamp of when the lead generation form was created. |
| results.{form_urn}.creationLocale | Object | The locale (country and language) in which the lead generation form was created. |
| results.{form_urn}.name | String | The name of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.id | Integer | The ID of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.lastModified | Integer | The timestamp of when the lead generation form was last modified. |
| results.{form_urn}.state | String | The state of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content | Object | The content of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions | Array | A list of questions in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].name | String | The name of a question in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails | Object | Details about a question in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails.multipleChoiceQuestionDetails | Object | Details specific to a multiple-choice question. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails.multipleChoiceQuestionDetails.options | Array | A list of options for a multiple-choice question. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails.multipleChoiceQuestionDetails.options\[\].text | String | The text of an option for a multiple-choice question. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.description | String | The description of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo | Object | Information about the legal aspects of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.consents | Array | A list of consents required by the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.consents\[\].consent | Object | Information about a consent required by the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.consents\[\].checkRequired | Boolean | Indicates whether the consent is required to submit the form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.privacyPolicyUrl | String | The URL to the privacy policy associated with the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.legalDisclaimer | Object | The legal disclaimer associated with the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.headline | String | The headline of the lead generation form. |
| statuses | Object | A dictionary containing the statuses of the lead generation forms. |
| statuses.{form_urn} | Integer | The status of a specific lead generation form identified by its URN. |
| errors | Object | A dictionary containing any errors that occurred during the request. |

Please note that the actual values of the fields may vary and have been omitted in this description for brevity.

This endpoint allows developers to retrieve information about a specific versioned lead generation form.

#### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | Integer | The unique identifier of the lead generation form |

#### Response Fields

In the event of a successful request, the response will contain the following fields:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| owner | String | The owner of the lead generation form |
| hiddenFields | Array | An array of hidden fields, each containing a name and value |
| versionId | Integer | The version ID of the lead generation form |
| created | Integer | The timestamp of when the lead generation form was created |
| creationLocale | Object | An object containing the country and language of the lead generation form |
| name | String | The name of the lead generation form |
| id | Integer | The unique identifier of the lead generation form |
| lastModified | Integer | The timestamp of when the lead generation form was last modified |
| state | String | The current state of the lead generation form |
| content | Object | An object containing the content of the lead generation form, including questions, description, legal information, and headline |

The 'content' object contains the following fields:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| questions | Array | An array of questions, each containing a question ID, localized question text, response editability, name, question details, and predefined field |
| description | Object | An object containing the localized description of the lead generation form |
| legalInfo | Object | An object containing consents, legal information ID, privacy policy URL, and legal disclaimer |
| headline | Object | An object containing the localized headline of the lead generation form |

Each question object in the 'questions' array contains the following fields:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| questionId | Integer | The question ID |
| question | Object | An object containing the localized question text |
| responseEditable | Boolean | Indicates whether the response is editable |
| name | String | The name of the question |
| questionDetails | Object | An object containing details about the question, such as max response length |
| predefinedField | String | The predefined field of the question |
| responseRequired | Boolean | Indicates whether a response is required |

The 'legalInfo' object contains the following fields:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| consents | Array | An array of consents, each containing a consent object with localized consent text and check requirement |
| legalInfoId | Integer | The legal information ID |
| privacyPolicyUrl | String | The URL of the privacy policy |
| legalDisclaimer | Object | An object containing the localized legal disclaimer |

In the event of an error, the response will contain an empty object.
